title: Follow-up for #1365: transition: normal normal 1s
items: Transition::to_css: when transition-property is an unknown name equal (ASCII case-insensitively) to `normal` or `allow-discrete`, write the behavior keyword before the property so it round-trips. `transition: normal normal 1s` currently becomes `transition:normal 1s`, which browsers read as `all 1s`; the same happens on master when longhands fold. Add tests in test_transitions.
